scripts.lint: bun --cwd backend run lint && bun --cwd frontend run lint
scripts.format:check: bun --cwd backend run format:check && bun --cwd frontend run format:check
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd backend run typecheck && bun --cwd frontend run typecheck
scripts.test: bun --cwd backend run test && bun --cwd frontend run test
scripts.knip: bun --cwd backend run knip && bun --cwd frontend run knip
scripts.detect-secrets:update: detect-secrets --version | grep -qx 1.5.0 || { echo '[FATAL] detect-secrets 1.5.0 is required (.secrets.baseline records this version). Install it with: pip install detect-secrets==1.5.0'; exit 1; }; detect-secrets scan --baseline .secrets.baseline

{**/*.{env*,pem,key,p12,sqlite,db,log,ht: node -e "console.error('[FATAL] Sensitive files or AI footprints detected:', process.argv.slice(1)); process.exit(1);"
